office_films.speech_p1: WELCOME TO SECONDHAND STUDIOS! HERE, EVERY AI AGENT IS AN ANIMATOR WITH A DEDICATED DESK ON OUR 7-PLANE RIG!

office_films.title: Why Every Agent Animator Gets a Private Desk
office_films.speech_p1: IF FOUR AGENT ANIMATORS DRAW ON ONE SHEET AT ONCE, OUR INK SMUDGES! SO EACH AGENT WORKS IN AN ISOLATED WORKTREE BOOTH!
office_films.caption_p2: HOW ISOLATED WORKTREE DRAFTING BOOTHS PREVENT INK COLLISIONS:
office_films.caption_p3: INSIDE BOOTH #324, I INK FOUR 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF THE STEAM TRAIN:
office_films.gutter_note: EACH KEYFRAME IS DRAWN IN AN ISOLATED GIT WORKTREE BEFORE SPLICING ONTO THE MASTER REEL!
office_films.caption_p4: THE COMPLETED TRAIN REEL PASSES ALL 16 GATES WITH ZERO CONFLICTS!
office_films.blurb: Keyframe Architect 'Blue-Line' explains why parallel AI agents need isolated git worktree drafting desks so their drawings never overwrite one another.

office_films.title: Why One Agent Draws and Another Agent Audits
office_films.speech_p1: IN OUR STUDIO, NO AGENT GRADES ITS OWN HOMEWORK! I PROJECT EVERY REEL IN THE SCREENING ROOM TO AUDIT ALL 16 GATES!
office_films.caption_p2: OUR TWO-AGENT PEER REVIEW LOOP IN THE SCREENING THEATRE:
office_films.caption_p3: I INSPECT ALL FOUR 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #136 GUITAR:
office_films.gutter_note: SPROCKET CHECKS LINE WEIGHT, 4:3 FRAMING, AND PARALLAX SEPARATION ACROSS EVERY KEYFRAME!

office_films.blurb: Projectionist & Critic 'Sprocket' explains why separating the Animator Agent (Claude) from the Dailies Auditor Agent (Codex) prevents hallucinations and guarantees 16/16 studio gates.

office_films.wing_name: EPISODE 05 // LIVING LINE BOIL VS. SLIDING
office_films.install: git clone https://github.com/pablodelucca/pixel-agents.git && cd pixel-agents && npm install
office_films.title: Four Parallel Inkers Create Living Line Boil
office_films.speech_p1: SLIDING ONE DEAD CUTOUT ACROSS THE SCREEN LOOKS ROBOTIC! FOUR INKER AGENTS REDRAW FOUR DISTINCT POSES SO THE LINE BREATHES!
office_films.caption_p2: FOUR SUBAGENT INKERS REDRAW KEYFRAMES K1, K2, K3 & K4:
office_films.caption_p3: COMPARE THE FOUR HAND-DRAWN 4:3 TRACTOR POSES ON THE STRIP:
office_films.gutter_note: BECAUSE EACH KEYFRAME IS FRESHLY INKED, THE TRACTOR CHUGS FORWARD WITH ORGANIC HAND-DRAWN BOIL!
office_films.caption_p4: THE TRACTOR ROLLS ACROSS THE FURROWS WITH GENUINE WEIGHT!
office_films.blurb: Blue-Line shows how spawning 4 subagent inkers in parallel to draw 4 distinct keyframes eliminates robotic affine sliding and produces authentic hand-drawn line boil.

office_films.install: git clone https://github.com/m1heng/my-office.git && cd my-office && npm install && npm run build
office_films.title: Keeping Studio Continuity Across Shift Changes
office_films.speech_p1: WHEN AN AGENT'S 55-MINUTE MEMORY WINDOW EXPIRES, DO WE LOSE THE STORY? NEVER! WE SEAL THE MASTER EXPOSURE SHEET!
office_films.caption_p2: BEFORE THE 55-MINUTE CLOCK CHIMES, WE LOG THE X-SHEET:
office_films.caption_p3: EVERY 4:3 SPEEDBOAT KEYFRAME REMEMBERS THE EXACT CAMERA ARC:
office_films.gutter_note: CHIME RECORDS PALETTE SWATCHES, PLANE DEPTHS, AND VELOCITY VECTORS ON THE EXPOSURE SHEET!
office_films.caption_p4: THE NEXT AGENT SHIFT PICKS UP SEAMLESSLY AS THE SPEEDBOAT PLANES!
office_films.blurb: Continuity Keeper 'Chime' explains how sealing the studio Exposure Sheet (X-Sheet) before the 55-minute prompt-cache chime keeps visual continuity unbroken across shift changes.

office_films.title: Separating Sky, Trees, and Hero Across 7 Glass Planes
office_films.speech_p1: HOW DO CLOUDS, TREES, AND THE BICYCLE GLIDE AT DIFFERENT SPEEDS? WE STACK THEM ON SEVEN SEPARATE GLASS PLANES!
office_films.caption_p2: THE MULTIPLANE TOWER ASSIGNS EACH GLASS LEVEL ITS PARALLAX:
office_films.caption_p3: WATCH THE BICYCLE PEDAL FORWARD ACROSS FOUR 4:3 KEYFRAMES:
office_films.gutter_note: DISTANT SKY DRIFTS SLOWLY AT 0.2x WHILE MIDGROUND TREES PASS AT 0.5x AND THE BICYCLE AT 1.0x!
office_films.caption_p4: PROJECTED TOGETHER, FLAT PAPER GAINS TRUE MULTIPLANE DEPTH!
office_films.blurb: Cel-Inker takes us up the 7-level Multiplane Camera Tower to show how separating Sky (0.2x), Midground Trees (0.5x), and Hero (1.0x) creates dimensional parallax.

office_films.title: How a Shot Travels Across Our Four Studio Desks
office_films.speech_p1: NO SINGLE AGENT TRIES TO DO EVERYTHING AT ONCE! EVERY SHOT TRAVELS ACROSS FOUR SPECIALIST DESKS IN ORDER!
office_films.caption_p2: FROM ARCHIVAL TRACE TO KEYFRAMES TO GOUACHE TO MASTER REEL:
office_films.caption_p3: HERE ARE THE FOUR STRUCTURAL 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #063 CARROT:
office_films.gutter_note: EACH DEPARTMENT AGENT SIGNS OFF ON THE EXPOSURE SHEET BEFORE PASSING THE FOLDER TO THE NEXT DESK!
office_films.caption_p4: CRAFT AND GOUACHE TEXTURE BRING THE SIMPLE CARROT DOODLE TO LIFE!
office_films.blurb: Showrunner Nib walks through the 4-desk studio Kanban pipeline: Storyboard Pin-Up -> 4-Keyframe Inking -> 7-Plane Gouache Painting -> Steenbeck Vault Splice.

office_films.title: Synchronizing Archival Footage with Multiplane Ink
office_films.speech_p1: HOW DO WE PROVE OUR CARTOON HONORS THE ORIGINAL VIDEO'S MOTION? WE LOCK BOTH REELS IN OUR TWIN PROJECTOR!

office_films.caption_p3: FRAME 1 SHOWS THE ARCHIVAL TRACE; FRAMES 2-4 SHOW OUR 4:3 KEYS:
office_films.gutter_note: SPROCKET VERIFIES THAT THE DIAMOND'S CENTER OF GRAVITY FOLLOWS THE EXACT ARCHIVAL TRAJECTORY!
office_films.caption_p4: LEFT: 4:3 ARCHIVAL PENCIL TRACE — RIGHT: 4:3 MULTIPLANE CARTOON!
office_films.blurb: Sprocket demonstrates the Twin-Reel Dailies Projector, locking the archival reference trace beside the newly inked 7-plane cartoon in true 4:3 aspect ratio.

skill_films.title: Directing the Camera: Wide, Medium, and Hero Framing
skill_films.speech_p1: A GREAT AGENT ANIMATOR DOESN'T JUST DRAW—WE DIRECT THE CAMERA! WIDE ESTABLISHING, MEDIUM ACTION, THEN HERO FOCUS!
skill_films.caption_p2: THREE CLASSIC CAMERA FRAMINGS USED BY OUR AGENT DIRECTORS:

skill_films.title: Cranking the Multiplane Camera Across 7 Glass Planes
skill_films.speech_p1: WHEN WE CRANK THE MULTIPLANE CAMERA ACROSS THE CAMPFIRE, OUR 7 GLASS PLANES SHIFT IN PARALLAX SO FLAT PAPER FEELS DEEP!
skill_films.caption_p2: HOW OUR CAMERA AGENT COORDINATES FOREGROUND AND BACKGROUND:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR FLICKERING 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #042 CAMPFIRE:

skill_films.title: Blocking the Stage Floor Before Calling 'Action!'
skill_films.speech_p1: BEFORE THE CAMERA ROLLS ON TAKE ONE, EVERY PROP, SHADOW, AND KEYFRAME MUST HIT ITS MARK ON THE STAGE FLOOR!
skill_films.caption_p2: THREE CHECKS BEFORE OUR AGENT DIRECTOR SNAPS THE CLAPPER:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR PRECISION 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #071 CLOCK:
skill_films.gutter_note: THE PENDULUM AND HANDS ADVANCE CLEANLY ACROSS ALL FOUR KEYFRAMES WITHOUT CLIPPING THE BORDER!

skill_films.blurb: Blue-Line and Sprocket demonstrate the Take-One pre-roll checklist: stage blocking, clapperboard sync, and 4-keyframe timing verification.

skill_films.title: Turning Archival Video into Living Hand-Drawn Ink
skill_films.speech_p1: HOW DO WE REANIMATE RAW ARCHIVAL VIDEO INTO HAND-DRAWN INK? WE TRACE THE MOTION SPINE AND DRAW FOUR FRESH KEYFRAMES!
skill_films.caption_p3: FROM PENCIL TRACE (FRAME 1) TO PAINTED 4:3 KEYFRAMES (2-4):
skill_films.gutter_note: WE NEVER BLUR PHOTOREAL PIXELS—WE RE-INK THE MOTION ENTIRELY IN QUICK, DRAW! LINE & GOUACHE!
skill_films.caption_p4: THE ARCHIVAL GIRAFFE REBORN AS A 7-PLANE MULTIPLANE CARTOON!
skill_films.blurb: Blue-Line and Cel-Inker reveal the core Reanimate workflow: extracting the motion trajectory from archival video and re-inking it as a 7-plane cartoon.

skill_films.title: Guarding Every Frame Against Edge Clipping & Drift
skill_films.speech_p1: IF A HOT-AIR BALLOON DRIFTS OFF THE PAPER EDGE, I STOP THE PRESSES! EVERY REEL MUST PASS ALL 16 STUDIO QUALITY GATES!
skill_films.caption_p2: THREE CRITICAL QUALITY GATES CHECKED BY SPROCKET:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR CENTERED 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #152 HOT-AIR BALLOON:
skill_films.gutter_note: SPROCKET CONFIRMS SAFE MARGINS, TRUE 4:3 ASPECT RATIO, AND FULL SKY-TO-CLOUD PARALLAX!
skill_films.caption_p4: THE HOT-AIR BALLOON RISES SMOOTHLY THROUGH THE PAINTED SKY!
skill_films.blurb: Auditor Sprocket demonstrates the Argo 16-gate inspection harness, checking margin safety, true 4:3 aspect ratios, and multiplane parallax.

skill_films.title: Why Simple Cartoons Explain Complex Systems Best
skill_films.speech_p1: NEVER BURY THE VIEWER IN FLOATING TELEMETRY NUMBERS! LET ONE CLEAR DIAGRAM AND ONE LIVING CARTOON TELL THE STORY!
skill_films.caption_p2: HOW OUR STUDIO TURNS COMPLEX DATA INTO CLEAR SEQUENTIAL ART:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR UNCLUTTERED 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF THE COASTAL LIGHTHOUSE:
skill_films.gutter_note: BY STRIPPING AWAY TECHNICAL OVERLAYS, YOUR EYE READS THE BEAM AND WAVES INSTANTLY!
skill_films.caption_p4: CLEAN PAPER, BOLD INDIA INK, AND UNOBSTRUCTED 4:3 MOTION!
skill_films.blurb: Nib explains the studio's visual storytelling philosophy: stripping away noisy telemetry labels so clear icons and sequential panels communicate immediately.

skill_films.title: Harmonizing Paper, Ink, and Gouache Across 346 Films
skill_films.speech_p1: ACROSS ALL 346 SHOTS, OUR AGENT STUDIO BALANCES CREAM PAPER, INDIA INK, AND GOUACHE SO EVERY REEL FEELS UNIFIED!
skill_films.caption_p2: THREE VISUAL PILLARS OF OUR UNIFIED STUDIO AESTHETIC:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR HARMONIZED 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #136 GUITAR:
skill_films.gutter_note: EVERY SHOT IN THE ARCHIVE SHARES THE EXACT SAME WARM PAPER AND WATERCOLOR GOUACHE PALETTE!
skill_films.caption_p4: UNIFIED COLOR, LINE WEIGHT, AND 4:3 FRAMING IN EVERY REEL!
skill_films.blurb: Sprocket and Nib show how the Video Director Skill enforces a single cohesive warm-paper and gouache palette across all 346 films.

skill_films.title: Triggering Foley Sound Effects on Motion Peaks
skill_films.speech_p1: SILENT INK COMES ALIVE WITH SOUND! I WATCH THE 3D MOTION CURVE FOR SHARP ACCELERATION PEAKS TO TRIGGER EVERY FOLEY CUE!
skill_films.caption_p2: HOW CHIME SYNCS FOLEY SOUND EFFECTS TO THE ANIMATION:
skill_films.caption_p3: FOUR 4:3 KEYFRAMES OF SHOT #324 TRAIN WITH ACOUSTIC CUES:
skill_films.gutter_note: WHENEVER THE TRAIN CHUGS OR WHISTLES AT PEAK ACCELERATION, CHIME DROPS A FRAME-ACCURATE FOLEY MARKER!
skill_films.caption_p4: PICTURE AND FOLEY LOCKED TOGETHER ON THE MASTER SOUNDTRACK!
skill_films.blurb: Foley Engineer 'Chime' demonstrates how Earshot detects acceleration peaks along the 3D motion curve to trigger frame-accurate Foley sound effects.
